warnings: Dataset is very small. This model is intended for DEMONSTRATION only and is not yet production validated.
This is a proof-of-concept visual inspection model trained on a very small dataset. Results must be validated with a significantly larger production dataset before deployment.
Model performance may be affected by camera pose, lighting, product orientation and background. For production deployment, images should be captured using controlled camera and lighting conditions.
